name: Summon Slime and Fungi
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [see text];; Level: cleric 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, witch 4

Components: V, S, F/DF (a piece of rotting food or flesh and a small candle)

Casting Time: 1 round

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target(s): One summoned creature

Duration: 1 round/2 levels (D)

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

This spell works like summon monster, but summons a random ooze, slime, mold or fungus from the list below, depending on the caster’s level. If the caster does not meet the minimum required caster level for the creature, roll again. The caster must specify where the random creature will appear before rolling to see which creature is actually summoned.

d10	Minimum Caster Level	Monster(s)
1-2	7	1d3 shriekers (use splash damage diagram to determine exact location of each shrieker)
3	7	Mold, brown (10 ft. square)
4	7	Gray ooze
5	8	Green slime (10 ft. square)
6	8	Mold, yellow (10 ft. square)
7	8	Violet fungus
8	8	Gelatinous cube
9	9	Mold, russet (10 ft. square)
10	9	Ochre jelly
